edges.child_node: "DeMarce short stories in the The Grantville Gazettes"

Id1.text: DeMarce short stories in the Grantville Gazettes preceded 1634: The Bavarian Crisis. Its author is Eric Flint.

Id2.text: 1634: The Bavarian Crisis was written by Eric Flint and DeMarce, who had also written short stories for the Grantville Gazettes.

Id3.text: DeMarce short stories in the Grantville Gazettes preceded 1634: The Bavarian Crisis, written by Eric Flint.
